title: Is that you, John?
evenTitleZh: 他想知道是否／为什么／什么／什么时候

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: Is that you, John?

lines.speaker: John Smith
lines.en: Yes, speaking.

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.
lines.zh: 你告诉玛丽，今晚吃饭我们将晚到一会儿。

lines.speaker: John Smith
lines.en: I'm afraid I don't understand.
lines.zh: 恐怕我还不明白您的意思。

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: Hasn't Mary told you?

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: She invited Charlotte and me to dinner this evening.
lines.zh: 她邀请我和夏洛特今晚去吃饭。

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: I said I would be at your house at six o'clock,

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: but the boss wants me to do some extra work.

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: I'll have to stay at the office.

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: I don't know when I'll finish.
lines.zh: 不知道什么时候才能结束。

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: Oh, and by the way,

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: my wife wants to know if Mary needs any help.
lines.zh: 我妻子想知道玛丽是否需要帮忙。

lines.speaker: John Smith
lines.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
lines.zh: 我不知道您在说些什么。

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: That is John Smith, isn't it?

lines.speaker: John Smith
lines.en: Yes, I'm John Smith.

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: You are John Smith, the engineer, aren't you?
lines.zh: 你是工程师约翰·史密斯，对吗？

lines.speaker: John Smith
lines.en: That's right.

lines.speaker: Graham Turner
lines.en: You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don't you?
lines.zh: 你在海外工程公司上班，是吗？

lines.speaker: John Smith
lines.en: No, I don't.

lines.speaker: John Smith
lines.en: I'm John Smith the telephone engineer
lines.zh: 我是电话工程师约翰·史密斯，

lines.speaker: John Smith
lines.en: and I'm repairing your telephone line.
lines.zh: 我正在修理您的电话线。
